title: Entitled Drunk Woman Busted After Trying to Escape Accident Scene
description:
On August 24th, 2024. A 911 call was placed due to an older woman fleeing the scene of an accident she had caused, although the accident was minor and no injuries occurred, the victim was more worried about the suspects' well-being. The officers tracked the woman to her house & quickly noticed she was in no condition to be driving, when the officer asked her what was going on with her, all she said was she's having a migraine, she also stated that she did not cause any damages, even though the officer pointed out the damages on her car.
